'#CDD3DD' : tone in HUE_PALETTES ? HUE_PALETTES[tone as Hue][300] : theme.mutedBar return ( {label} {delta} {primary.label} {primary.display ?? primary.value.toLocaleString('en-US')} {secondary.label} {secondary.display ?? secondary.value.toLocaleString('en-US')} ) }
